newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish industrial climate flat in Sept - stat office.
newsitem.headline: Polish industrial climate flat in Sept - stat office.

text.p: Poland's business climate in the manufacturing sector stayed positive in September but companies' expectations were less optimistic than in August, a monthly survey by the Central Statistics Office (GUS) showed.

GUS said on Friday its industrial climate index for September was unchanged at six points, but while companies saw their situation improving in October the expected improvement was not as big as the August survey showed.
GUS said the companies polled signalled a drop in domestic demand which depressed the overall demand index, but still expected a rise in demand in the next three months.
It said the construction sector climate fell for the fifth month running, dropping 10 points to 24 points as expectations about future orders worsened.
BUSINESS OUTLOOK SEPT AUGUST JULY JUNE MAY SEPT 95
NOTE: The indicator is a percentage balance between positive and negative responses from polled companies.
